purpose: Offline readable source mirror; not a runtime patch
namingPolicy: Confirmed semantic names without opaque suffixes; unknown symbols stay unchanged. Original spellings and JVM identities remain in the reverse symbol map. Every rule guards the original spelling. Local identities also use declaration ordinals; reused variables retain all supported roles. Numeric screen/action IDs and decompiler state remain unchanged.
